lessons: `pnpm up -r` re-resolves the whole graph AND rewrites `catalog:` specifiers into inline pins + exact pins into carets — it produced a 1198-line lockfile diff and broke two manifest contracts. Surgical `pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile` (which preserves existing resolutions) produced 128 lines with no manifest drift.

`resolutionMode: lowest-direct` + a range override beats an exact manifest pin: zod stayed 4.4.3 because the override floor was `>=4.4.0`. The OVERRIDE FLOOR is the effective control lever for direct deps — now guarded by a test.
`minimumReleaseAge: 7200` (5 days) rejected 8 of 19 planned targets; the newest allowed patch had to be computed from registry publish times.
Dependabot alerts/security updates work with no config file (repository setting); version updates do not. Their absence here was not a bug but a missing `.github/` directory.
GitHub forbids overlapping `directory` values for the same ecosystem+target branch, and pnpm workspaces need one PR per dependency -> `directories` + `group-by: dependency-name`.

Dependabot `ignore` also applies to SECURITY updates (official docs), and version updates only touch manifest-declared dependencies — so ignoring a TRANSITIVE package has no upside and can silently skip a security-update PR. Enforced by a test.
